regional_summary_6h.headline: Iranian-US maritime clash in Strait of Hormuz and Gulf of Oman sets dominant threat tempo
bullets: IRGC claims strike on an American unmanned surface vessel in Hormuz while Centcom reports an Iranian oil tanker sunk in the Gulf of Oman, signaling direct US-Iran kinetic escalation on Iran's southern maritime flank.
Two major Iran-theater military events in under two hours overshadow quieter political strain in northeast Syria over alcohol curbs, keeping Iran as the regional bellwether.
Force-on-force incidents in the Gulf raise spillover risk for Iran's western border posture and could indirectly pressure border-security and militant-violence dynamics in adjacent theaters.
regional_summary_6h.watch: Track Iranian retaliation signaling and any cross-border force movements following the Hormuz and Gulf of Oman incidents.
